title: GMI Paired Functional Screening Analysis
description: Python analysis workflow for paired ex vivo functional screening under PBS- and GMI-modulated conditions. Version 1.1.1 reissues the independent-validation release after the GitHub v1.1.0 source archive failed to attach to Zenodo. The release includes independent validation for cases A043, A166, and A180 using PBS, active GMI, and heat-inactivated GMI conditions; reverse-audited plate-level quality control; complete assay-well mapping; original-versus-validation reproducibility analyses across 175 identity-matched compounds; within-validation active-GMI versus heat-inactivated-GMI comparisons across all 178 compounds; DeltaMin and DeltaAUC analyses; 3,000-resample bootstrap confidence intervals; directional concordance; paired Wilcoxon signed-rank testing; Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate correction; and validation figure-generation scripts and processed source-data outputs. No scientific data, analyses, results, or conclusions were changed from version 1.1.0.
